claim: For every irreducible \(F(x)=x^6+a x^m+b\in\mathbb Z[x]\) with \(m\in\{2,4\}\), \(9\mid a\), and \(b\equiv1\pmod9\), if \(K=\mathbb Q(\theta)\) for a root \(\theta\), then \(\nu_3([\mathcal O_K:\mathbb Z[\theta]])=2\).

integrity.proof_basis: Explicit phi-Newton-polygon calculation and Ore index theorem

scientific_limitations: Applies only to irreducible sextic trinomials with m in {2,4}, 9 dividing a, and b congruent to 1 modulo 9.
Determines the index of the defining root, not the common index of the field and not field monogenity.
A related general trinomial-monogenity paper was not retrieved in full; a residual overlap risk remains.
title: Exact 3-adic root-index valuation for even sextic trinomials
